title: Brazil player ratings vs Morocco: Vinicius Jr rescues the Selecao as dreary Casemiro display leaves Carlo Ancelotti with more questions than answers
desc: EAST RUTHERFORD, N.J. -- Vinicius Jr scored a wonderful goal to give life to an otherwise languid Brazil performance, and they settled for a 1-1 draw with Morocco to open their World Cup play. The Selecao started slow, conceded, but a moment of magic from their main man gave them parity before the break. Both sides, it seems, will likely take the point with weaker opposition to come.
